# TDengine IDMP

Skills that teach agents to work with TDengine IDMP. They are copied from the vendor's repository, [taosdata/agent-skills](https://github.com/taosdata/agent-skills), at commit `bf51977`.

TDengine IDMP plugin with packaged skills for discovery, schema inspection, and safe operational workflows.

## Install

- **BoldCreate Connect:** open **Marketplace**, find **TDengine IDMP**, and click **Install**.
- **Cursor:** add this repository as a team marketplace, then install **TDengine IDMP**.
- **Claude Code:** `/plugin marketplace add syncfusion/BoldCreate-Plugins`, then `/plugin install idmp-plugin@boldcreate-plugins`.

## Skills

23 skills: `idmp-ai`, `idmp-analysis`, `idmp-annotation`, `idmp-attribute`, `idmp-dashboard`, `idmp-data`, `idmp-datasource`, `idmp-element`, `idmp-event`, `idmp-notification`, `idmp-openapi-explorer`, `idmp-panel`, `idmp-shared`, `idmp-template`, `idmp-uom`, `idmp-user-access`, `idmp-workflow-alert-create`, `idmp-workflow-alert-debug`, `idmp-workflow-analysis-create`, `idmp-workflow-asset-bootstrap`, `idmp-workflow-data-import-export`, `idmp-workflow-datasource-diagnose`, `idmp-workflow-panel-build`.

## Setup

No install-time settings.

## Before you install

It ships no scripts. The skills are guidance for the agent.
